indicator_definition: This indicator measures the share of rail and inland waterways in total inland freight transport, expressed as a percentage of total tonne-kilometres. It reflects the modal split of freight transport and the use of more sustainable modes. Data are compiled by Eurostat from national transport statistics.
rationale: Shifting freight from road to rail and inland waterways reduces greenhouse gas emissions, congestion and accidents. Increasing the share of these sustainable modes is a key EU transport policy objective. Progress means an increasing share of rail and inland waterways in total inland freight transport.
methodology_characteristics: Data are compiled by Eurostat from national transport statistics under EU transport data regulations. Freight transport is measured in tonne-kilometres. Rail and inland waterways are compared to total inland freight (road, rail and inland waterways combined). Data are published annually.
indicator_name: Share of rail and inland waterways in freight transport
